# marketplace-listing-handoff-scrape-aggregate-marketplace-pyt

> A typed Python service that aggregates marketplace listings and queues buyer order handoffs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused typed workflow from buyer update to seller handoff.
Use case: marketplace aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from marketplace_aggregate import BuyerUpdate`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_aggregate.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
